overview: The Berklee Institute of Jazz and Gender Justice quartet performed a selection of jazz standards written by women and non-binary composers at the Medford Jazz Fest 2026.

items.title: Introduction of the Berklee Institute of Jazz and Gender Justice
items.summary: Terry Carter introduced the quartet members and described the institute's mission to advocate for gender justice and equity in jazz.

items.title: Performance of 'Respected Destroyer' and 'Blue Nile'
items.summary: The quartet performed 'Respected Destroyer' by Brandee Younger and introduced 'Blue Nile' by Alice Coltrane, both featured in the New Standards book.

items.title: Performance of 'Shorty's Portion' and 'Throw It Away'
items.summary: The band followed their performance of Patrice Rushen's 'Shorty's Portion' with 'Throw It Away' by Abbey Lincoln.

items.title: Performance of 'Unconditional Love'
items.summary: The quartet introduced and performed their final piece, 'Unconditional Love' by Geri Allen.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: Terry Carter concluded the set by thanking the musicians, acknowledging each member of the quartet, and preparing for the next performance.

subject: Berklee Institute Quartet Performance
